This page collates how a character is built from the rules documents, step by step, '''as they are written today'''. It adds no rules of its own; where the documents are silent it says so. The rules themselves are on [[SL100:Characteristics]], [[SL100:Species]], [[SL100:Origin]], [[SL100:Careers]] and the Faction page.


Collated by <code>tools/collate/assembly.py</code> from the Characteristics, Species, Origin, Faction and Careers pages. Everything below is quoted or tabulated from the documents; nothing has been added or decided. Where a document is silent, that is shown as a gap. Full tables: <code>species.csv</code>, <code>origins.csv</code>, <code>careers_l1.csv</code>, <code>factions.csv</code>.

== What each layer says about the next (cross-references in the text) ==

* Characteristics -> Origin: "(not found on Characteristics)"
* Characteristics step order: "(not found on Characteristics)"
* Origin -> Faction: "The circumstances of your early life are known as your Origin. It can determine some of your Characteristics and your chances of being part of a specific Faction."
* Faction -> Patron / Force traditions: "Your Faction describes the focus of your life until you were recruited by your Patron. Some Factions search for specific attributes, such as force sensitivity to join a Force Tradition, for the Black Sun as an example it could be a myriad of things ..."
